items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: No, he didn't teach nobody, they just got points from him.

ctx.x: No, he didn't teach nobody, they just got points from him. What makes them what they are is what they heard him do. Something that they heard him do. Oh, he could play the piano awhile. I know you've heard a record of his somewhere.
Were there other outlets for Buck? Did Buck want to go off on his own as just a pianist? Did he ever consider that?
